title: Consistent Path Selection for Bi-objective Median Location Problems on Graphs
summary: We consider single-facility median location problems on graphs where two conflicting cost values are associated with the edges. As an example, suppose that a decision maker wants to locate one new facility, e. g., a pizza delivery place, which uses bicycles for delivery. The two objective functions could then be the total traveling time and the total number of left turns, as the latter are very risky.
